acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of backyard remodeling in Las Vegas can vary widely due to several factors, including the size of your yard, the materials chosen, and the complexity of the design. Basic landscaping updates might start in the low thousands, while comprehensive remodels with features like outdoor kitchens, custom hardscaping, and intricate water features can range significantly higher.
